text_to_speech: you know I'm so glad you asked that because it was really an aha mathematics moment and it happened to me in the fifth grade and I happened to have one of these wonderful teachers who knew how to take mathematics and connect it to Art and music and history and English and Science and I remember her teaching us this origami kirigami activity origami means to fold paper but once it's folded if you cut it it's called kirigami and she had us all fold the paper she had us all make the snipped and I remember opening up the treasure and thinking oh my gosh this is mathematics and it had absolutely nothing to do with numbers so it captivated me and it moved me in the direction of geometry which of course is the mathematics of shape and measurement and that's where my passion happens to be
